about.title: The startup story, every day.
about.subtitle: Startup News Room is a daily digest of the headlines that matter to founders, operators and investors.
about.missionBody: We save you time. Every day we read across publications, pick the stories worth knowing and summarise each in a few sentences, always linking to the original reporting.
about.pickBody: Editors prioritise significance over noise: news that changes a market, a sector or how companies are built. We avoid press-release rewrites and unverified rumours.
about.standardsBody: Every summary credits its source and links to it. We correct errors quickly and transparently, and advertising never influences what we publish.

contact.tipBody: Raising a round, launching a product or know something we should cover? Send us the details and a link. We never publish a tip without verifying it.
contact.tipHintPrefix: Use the form and start your subject with
contact.tipHintSuffix: so it reaches the editors directly.

advertise.title: Advertise with us
advertise.subtitle: Reach the people building the next generation of companies, in a calm, uncluttered setting.
advertise.audienceBody: Founders, operators, investors and early employees who read the day's startup news every morning.
advertise.formatsBody: Newsletter sponsorships, a single native placement on the home page, and sponsored briefings on a chosen theme.
advertise.principlesBody: Every partnership is clearly labelled. Sponsors never influence editorial selection or summaries.
